ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~23 day(s) ago @ 156.49) and overbought (daily RSI 68, 3-day 75 & weekly 75). ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 68, 3-day 75 & weekly 75). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.

ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（约 23 天前形成 @ 156.49）且已超买（日线 RSI 68、3 日 75 与周线 75）。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
